effects.tier2: 11 damage; one target is [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed); one target is [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 2 squares
effects.tier3: 14 damage; one target is [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed); one target is vertical [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 3 squares

effects.effect: The ability takes the Area keyword and loses the Strike keyword, its distance becomes a 1 burst, and it targets each enemy in the area.
The roughneck can jump up to 5 squares to an unoccupied space within distance of the target before making this strike.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The target must be [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) by the roughneck.
effects.name: Special

effects.effect: The roughneck moves up to their speed across the ground, dragging the target with them. The target takes 2 damage for each square they were dragged through. When this movement ends, the target is no longer [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) and falls [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone). Each square the target was dragged through is difficult terrain for enemies.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The target must be [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) by the roughneck.
effects.name: Special

effects.effect: The target is vertical [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 5 squares. An ally doesn't take damage from being [force moved](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) this way.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The target is [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) by the roughneck.
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Catcher
features.trigger: A size 1 creature or object is [force moved](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) within distance, or a size 1 ally willingly moves within distance.

effects.effect: The roughneck uses Haymaker against a creature or object at any point during the forced movement, or after falling as a result of it.
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Flying Sawblade
features.trigger: The roughneck is vertical force moved by another creature.
